shared_notes.timeline_anchor_format: timeline_range.from/to are story_timeline.json story_time[].event IDs (ev0001-ev0054). Where two versions share one event, from_paragraph/to_paragraph (chNNN#pMM, inside that event's events.json source range) set the split. Narrative order equals story-time order for the whole film (story_timeline _meta.finding), so the story-time lookup and the narrative lookup give the same version. The only exception is the imagined inset, which is tagged with anachrony_ref.
shared_notes.general_rule: The film covers one afternoon (Friday 4 July 1862, about 2 pm to sunset). No character ages on screen. Size changes (SUP-003), the baby-to-pig change (SUP-006) and card/animal coding (SUP-002, SUP-004) are staging, not age versions. Past events that characters only describe in dialogue (an-02 the Hatter's 'last March', an-04 the Mock Turtle's schooldays, SUP-010 'told only') are not shown on screen, so they need no younger looks.

decisions.decision: not shown on screen; no version
decisions.reason: 'I'm grown up now... no room to grow up any more here' is a pun on her giant size in the Rabbit's house (SUP-003). 'Never to be an old woman' is a passing thought. The source shows no picture of an older Alice, and with no narration there is no voiceover to set one up.

decisions.topic: The sister's reverie of Alice as a grown woman (ch012#p71)
decisions.decision: shown on screen as a short, silent imagined insert inside ev0054; version CHAR-alice-age02 (about thirty, dressed in the 1862 style)
decisions.reason: This is the closing image of the book and the film's coming-of-age theme. With no narration and no line for the sister here, the beat can only survive as a picture. It is the sister's imagination with her eyes closed (subjective, not magic), so the realistic frame holds. The grown look uses 1862-style dress because the 1862 sister can only imagine the future in the clothes she knows. This keeps the rule that nothing on screen dates from after 1862.
decisions.if_cut: If the script cuts the ch012#p71 beat, CHAR-alice-age02 is simply unused. CHAR-alice-age01 still covers every other Alice shot.

decisions.topic: Little Alice in the sister's memory (ch012#p68)
decisions.decision: uses the base child version CHAR-alice-age01 (same look: tiny hands, bright eager eyes, head toss)
